serviceDescription: Beacon Assurance Partners, LLC is an independent assessment organization providing FedRAMP 20x verification and validation services for Cloud Service Offerings across Certification Classes A, B, and C, with particular depth in Rev5 control assessment for Class B and C offerings.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Full IVV services covering Key Security Indicator assessment, Rev5 control assessment where applicable, and evidence-of-effectiveness review per IVV-CSO and IVV-CSF rule families.
Assessment of controls with prior findings and mandatory-assessment controls per IVV-CSF-MCA and IVV-CSF-ACF.
Independent assessor review and sign-off for Transformative change notifications requiring third-party validation.

customerReferences: "Beacon's assessment team was thorough and responsive, and helped us close out our Class B assessment two weeks ahead of schedule." — Compliance Director, federal SaaS provider
